vars.label: Resident population
vars.definition: People living in the municipality: the 2010 and 2020 census counts (April 1) and the Census Bureau's July 1 estimates for the other years. Estimates for 2011-2019 were built on the 2010 census and were never revised after the 2020 count, so the series steps up in 2020; later years are built on the 2020 census. The 2020 figure is the April 2020 base of the latest estimates, which includes the Census Bureau's post-census count corrections, so a few municipalities differ from the original count by a handful of people.

vars.label: Population change since the 2010 census
vars.definition: Percent change from the 2010 census count to the selected year.

vars.label: Population change since the 2020 census
vars.definition: Percent change from the 2020 census base to the selected year (2021 onward).

vars.label: Residents aged 65 and over
vars.definition: Share of residents 65 or older, from the Census Bureau's population estimates by age and sex.

vars.label: Housing units, census count (number)
vars.definition: Housing units counted on census day (April 1), 2010 and 2020.

vars.label: Vacant units, census count (number)
vars.definition: Housing units vacant on census day.

vars.label: Vacancy rate, census count
vars.definition: Vacant units as a share of all housing units on census day. The American Community Survey puts vacancy higher (it is a five-year survey with its own vacancy test): neither is wrong, so compare each source only with itself.

vars.label: Residents per housing unit
vars.definition: Census population divided by census housing units (2010 and 2020). Below about 2 points to a surplus of homes over households.

vars.label: Housing units (number)
vars.definition: All housing units, occupied or vacant, from the American Community Survey five-year estimates.

vars.label: Vacant housing units (number)
vars.definition: Housing units with no one living in them, including homes for sale or rent, seasonal homes and abandoned units.

vars.label: Vacant housing units, % of all units
vars.definition: Share of all housing units that are vacant. Includes seasonal homes, units for sale or rent, and abandoned units.

vars.label: Seasonal, recreational or occasional-use units (number)
vars.definition: Units held for seasonal, recreational or occasional use: the closest public proxy for weekend homes and short-term rentals.

vars.label: Seasonal, recreational or occasional-use units, % of all units
vars.definition: Share of all units the Census classes as held for seasonal, recreational or occasional use. The best public proxy for weekend homes and short-term rentals.

vars.label: Other vacant units (number)
vars.definition: Vacant units that are not for sale, for rent, sold or rented, or seasonal. The usual public proxy for abandoned or dilapidated housing.

vars.label: Other vacant units, % of all units (abandoned-housing proxy)
vars.definition: Share of all units that are vacant for 'other' reasons: not for sale or rent, not seasonal. The usual public proxy for abandoned or dilapidated housing.

vars.label: Rental vacancy rate
vars.definition: Units for rent as a share of rental units (for rent, rented not yet occupied, and renter-occupied).

vars.label: Homeowner vacancy rate
vars.definition: Units for sale as a share of owner units (for sale, sold not yet occupied, and owner-occupied).

vars.label: Single-family detached homes
vars.definition: Share of housing units that are detached single-family houses.

vars.label: Units in buildings of 5 or more
vars.definition: Share of housing units in buildings with five or more units.

vars.label: Mobile homes
vars.definition: Share of housing units that are mobile homes.

vars.label: Median year the home was built
vars.definition: Median year the structure was built, for all housing units.

vars.label: Overcrowded homes (more than 1 person per room)
vars.definition: Occupied homes with more than one occupant per room.

vars.label: Households (occupied housing units)
vars.definition: Occupied housing units.

vars.label: Average household size
vars.definition: People per occupied home.

vars.label: Owner-occupied share of occupied units
vars.definition: Owner-occupied units as a share of all occupied units.

vars.label: Median age
vars.definition: Median age of residents, in years.

vars.label: Population below the poverty level
vars.definition: Share of people whose income in the past 12 months was below the poverty level.

vars.label: Employment rate (16 and over)
vars.definition: Employed civilians as a share of all residents 16 and over.

vars.label: Unemployment rate
vars.definition: Unemployed as a share of the civilian labor force.

vars.label: Adults 25+ with a bachelor's degree or higher
vars.definition: Share of adults 25 and over holding a bachelor's, master's, professional or doctoral degree.

vars.label: Median home value
vars.definition: Median value of owner-occupied homes, as estimated by their owners.

vars.label: Median gross rent
vars.definition: Median monthly gross rent, including utilities.

vars.label: Median household income
vars.definition: Median household income in the past 12 months, in that survey period's dollars (not adjusted for inflation).

vars.label: Per capita income
vars.definition: Income per person in the past 12 months, not adjusted for inflation.

vars.label: Median income of owner households
vars.definition: Median household income of owner-occupied households.

vars.label: Median income of renter households
vars.definition: Median household income of renter-occupied households.

vars.label: Median monthly owner costs, with a mortgage
vars.definition: Median selected monthly owner costs for homes with a mortgage (mortgage, taxes, insurance, utilities).

vars.label: Median monthly owner costs, no mortgage
vars.definition: Median selected monthly owner costs for homes without a mortgage.

vars.label: Median gross rent as a share of household income
vars.definition: Median of rent divided by income across renter households.

vars.label: Cost-burdened renters (30%+ of income on rent)
vars.definition: Renter households paying 30% or more of income in gross rent, excluding those where the ratio cannot be computed.

vars.label: Severely cost-burdened renters (50%+ of income)
vars.definition: Renter households paying half or more of income in gross rent.

vars.label: Cost-burdened owners with a mortgage (30%+ of income)
vars.definition: Owner households with a mortgage paying 30% or more of income in selected monthly owner costs.

vars.label: Maximum affordable 30-year loan
vars.definition: The largest 30-year mortgage the median household can carry spending 30% of income on housing, 78% of that on principal and interest (the study's Table 6 method), at a fixed 5% rate so that years differ only through incomes.

vars.label: Home ownership affordability ratio
vars.definition: Median home value divided by the largest 30-year loan the median household can carry (study method, fixed 5% rate). Above 1.0, the typical home is out of reach for the typical household.

vars.label: Households approved for FEMA housing assistance
vars.definition: Owner and renter households approved for FEMA Individual Assistance after a disaster declared that year, by municipality. Years with no declaration have no value.

vars.label: FEMA Individual Assistance approved
vars.definition: Dollars approved for owners and renters under FEMA Individual Assistance for disasters declared that year.
